name: Spaceship 781cc2ef on 4.6.12
description: A period-4 spaceship on the truncated trihexagonal tiling 4.6.12 (touching neighbours), 5 to 6 cells, moving one lattice step every 4 generations (c/4). It runs the same way in the 65,536 rules from B2/S2 to B2,5,6,7,8,9,10,11,12/S2,5,6,7,8,9,10,11,12; the scene uses the rule it was found in. Found by JETCARP's soup search (seen 373 times). Flagged as most likely already known: small (5 to 6 cells), common (seen 373 times) and wide-range (65,536 rules) on an Archimedean tiling. We found no earlier report, but others may well have seen it, so it is not claimed.
